method.causal_boundary: A subject is accepted only when its parent lacks the relevant vulnerable edge, the subject introduces that edge, the subject is an ancestor of the supplied fix parent, and the same exact subject has observable AI attribution in raw author, committer, trailer, or a recoverable squash member.
method.history_scope: Full reachable Git history and relevant pull refs were searched; blame/SZZ was used only as a locator, never as a hard boundary.
method.attribution_granularity: Commit-subject attribution, not line-level authorship. Raw squash co-author trailers satisfy the requested exact-subject gate, but recovered member-level caveats are preserved below.

cases.status_basis: The mainline squash subject 00b7649a introduced the HTTP attack surface and all three fixed resource/authentication weaknesses into a parent with no HTTP server. That exact subject has a raw Copilot co-author trailer and is an ancestor of the fix parent.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: Every non-health HTTP request reached the MCP transport without an Authorization check.
fix_mechanism.fix: Reads MCP_BEARER_TOKEN and enforces Authorization: Bearer <token> with timingSafeEqual when the variable is set, returning 401 and WWW-Authenticate on failure.
fix_mechanism.qualification: This commit only warns and remains unauthenticated when MCP_BEARER_TOKEN is unset; a later commit made the token mandatory. The review does not overstate 8f129724 as fail-closed authentication.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: POST chunks were accumulated until EOF and concatenated with no byte ceiling.
fix_mechanism.fix: readBodyWithLimit enforces MAX_BODY_BYTES=1,048,576 during streaming and returns a JSON-RPC 413 response on overflow.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: The Node HTTP server retained its unbounded default connection cap.

evidence: ac5251e:src/index.ts:1540 creates the HTTP server without an auth guard.
ac5251e:src/index.ts:1602-1606 accumulates every POST chunk and Buffer.concat()s the complete body without a size check.
No maxConnections assignment exists in the fix parent.
The fix adds the bearer-token guard, bounded reader, and maxConnections cap in the same request path.
parent_counterfactual.counterfactual_statement: Reverting 8f129724 to ac5251e restores all three weaknesses; reverting accepted origin 00b7649a to its parent removes HTTP mode entirely, so the vulnerable HTTP edges do not exist.

accepted_causal_subjects.subject: patch: Added HTTP server mode (#107)
semantic_edges: Introduced an HTTP MCP transport with no bearer-authentication check.
Introduced whole-body chunk accumulation with no byte limit.
Introduced an HTTP listener with no connection cap; the same squash also added configurable --host with default 0.0.0.0.
accepted_causal_subjects.parent_counterfactual: The parent contains no createServer, StreamableHTTPServerTransport, --http option, or HTTP request-body path.

squash_member_recovery.qualification: 6cca70b first added the vulnerable HTTP/body path without an AI marker; d2e79d has the Copilot trailer but only removes '= undefined'; 4935d adds the public bind default without an AI marker. Acceptance is therefore strictly at the exact squash-subject level, as allowed by the task, not a line-level claim.

Has a Copilot trailer, but its parent already contains every relevant weakness and its only relevant change is 'let body: unknown = undefined' to 'let body: unknown'. Counterfactual fails; no causal origin.

Expands exposure by adding --host and defaulting to 0.0.0.0 on the PR branch, but has no observable AI attribution and is not itself on fix ancestry. Its change is represented in the accepted squash subject.
Later session-management rewrite; parent already has the vulnerable HTTP surface, it does not add auth/body/connection guards, and it has no observable AI attribution.
Later multi-connection refactor; parent already has the relevant weaknesses and raw metadata has no AI signal.
The fix itself has Claude trailers, but a fix descendant cannot be its own causal origin; fix-side AI attribution is intentionally excluded.

cases.status_basis: Two exact ancestor subjects pass both causality and observable attribution: bot-authored 66ff2a7c adds raw timeframe interpolation to two capabilities, and Copilot-coauthored mainline squash 689fd87d adds list_exceptions with raw timeframe and additionalFilter interpolation. Seven other fixed semantic edges trace to subjects with no observable AI attribution and are rejected rather than stitched into the accepted claim.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: entityNames, clusterId, kubernetesEntityId, and eventType were embedded directly in double-quoted DQL strings.
fix_mechanism.fix: escapeDqlStringValue escapes backslashes and double quotes before embedding string values.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: Four free-form z.string() timeframe arguments were interpolated after now()- and could terminate or extend the DQL expression.
fix_mechanism.fix: validateTimeframe accepts only a positive integer and one duration unit via /^[1-9]\d*[smhdwMy]$/.

fix_mechanism.pre_fix: Three additionalFilter strings were intentionally inserted as filter expressions but also accepted pipe/newline delimiters for new pipeline stages.
fix_mechanism.fix: validateAdditionalFilter rejects pipe, LF, and CR before the expression is embedded.
fix_mechanism.qualification: Bracket subqueries remain intentionally permitted and scope-bounded, as documented by the fix.

evidence: 35db469:find-monitored-entity-by-name.ts:23,41 directly joins entityNames into DQL string literals.
35db469:get-events-for-cluster.ts:20,27 directly interpolates timeframe and cluster identifiers.
The MCP schemas expose entity names, IDs, timeframe, and additionalFilter as caller-controlled strings; eventType is constrained by z.enum and is not counted as an independently exploitable origin.
